remarks: Welcome to the epitome of urban living in the heart of South Norwalk (SONO)! Introducing this spacious studio apartment nestled in the trendy enclave of Washington Street. Step into a vibrant lifestyle where dining, shopping, and entertainment are just steps away from your doorstep. Imagine strolling out to an array of restaurants, boutique shops, and lively nightlife, all within arm's reach. For commuters, convenience is key. Embrace stress-free travel with easy access to the NY Metro line, ensuring seamless connections to the bustling city. Plus, with the SONO Collection shopping nearby, your retail therapy cravings are effortlessly fulfilled. With Municipal parking is conveniently located behind the building, providing hassle-free solutions for your vehicle. But it's not just about city living; it's about embracing the outdoors too. Enjoy leisurely strolls along the waterfront or unwind in the nearby public parks, immersing yourself in the natural beauty that South Norwalk has to offer. Experience the perfect blend of urban sophistication and suburban charm. Elevate your lifestyle today with this prime studio apartment in South Norwalk. Your urban oasis awaits!
